newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline broadly steady, arb to U.S reopens.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline broadly steady, arb to U.S reopens.

text.p: European gasoline prices were easier for much of the day, but recovered towards the close as U.S NYMEX gasoline showed some strength.
Eurograde barges traded between $214 and $216.50 fob AR and a regular barge was done at $207.50 fob.

The arbitrage to the U.S looks to have re-opened after sharp U.S falls shut the window earlier this week. But, traders said any transatlantic movement would have to be done on large cargoes, up to 80,000 tonnes, in order to limit exposure to high freight charges.
"From Ventspils to New York harbour the freight is $25 a tonne on 30,000 tonnes," commented one trader.
